title: Increasing Tangential Gain
statement: Increasing the tangential gain will help the robot navigate the tight turns of the chicane more effectively.
mechanism: By increasing the tangential gain, the robot will be more responsive to the tangential forces, allowing it to make tighter turns without stalling.
